_comment: Who speaks with which ElevenLabs voice. Lines are matched to characters by the names in translations/ui.csv (char_<id>); lines without a speaker are the author's ('narrator'). 'direction' is an eleven_v3 audio tag put in front of every line; 'expressions' override it for lines tagged 'Name [expression]:'; 'wordless' is what a line with no letters ('...') is spoken as. Keep tags in English for every language.
